authorization.scope: User explicitly requests a newly selected natural panel and frozen choices before scoring; fixed seed6206, 256 records per domain, previously reviewed candidate universe.

finance.rationale: The window starts at the published P04 Finance range stop (20000) and extends into a public-only candidate region; published identity ledgers still govern exact eligibility.

pile.rationale: A low-index public window is retained to provide a broad Pile domain; it may intersect published P05 fit identities, so every candidate remains subject to the bound opaque ID/hash/sequence exclusion index.

coverage_disclaimer.identity_index_policy: dataset/source row indices are retained as audit metadata only; they are not globally comparable and are never used alone to block a candidate
coverage_disclaimer.selection_policy: Selection is eligible only when all explicitly approved identity ledgers are bound and hash-stable; optional historical aliases are recorded as limitations and do not create a universal non-overlap claim.

supersedes.reason: bind P03 selected reservation identities, use published TRR0003 resource-manifest alias, and separate required readiness from optional descriptor coverage
